summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the inclusion and presentation of dwell time data in reports. It was noted that including high night-time dwell times (e.g., for a specific German location) could lead to unnecessary questions from clients.

**Decisions/Changes:**
*   Dwell time will be removed from the main report dashboard to prevent confusion and avoid unnecessary client inquiries.
*   The data is available on the product side but must be exported separately from a dedicated chart, as it is not included in the primary report view.
decisions: Remove dwell time from the main report dashboard
Dwell time should be extracted via separate charting/export rather than being part of the core report
action_items: [me] deployed the updated report (with dwell time removed) to staging.
[me] deployed the updated report to production.
